args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail)

June,

- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), so filtered views return both accounts.
- Moss's coverage check (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That title needs to change to the full account name.
- The 16 Mar coastal weekly lists two saved report titles that still say "Covey".
- I could not confirm from the records I can see whether the CRM code and name change were completed.

Sofia
